properties.name: server.netty.connection-timeout
properties.description: Connection timeout of the Netty channel.

properties.name: server.netty.h2c-max-content-length
properties.description: Maximum content length of an H2C upgrade request.

properties.name: server.netty.idle-timeout
properties.description: Idle timeout of the Netty channel. When not specified, an infinite timeout is used.

properties.name: server.netty.initial-buffer-size
properties.description: Initial buffer size for HTTP request decoding.

properties.name: server.netty.max-initial-line-length
properties.description: Maximum length that can be decoded for an HTTP request's initial line.

properties.name: server.netty.max-keep-alive-requests
properties.description: Maximum number of requests that can be made per connection. By default, a connection serves unlimited number of requests.

properties.name: server.netty.validate-headers
properties.description: Whether to validate headers when decoding requests.

properties.name: spring.reactor.netty.shutdown-quiet-period
properties.description: Amount of time to wait before shutting down resources.

deprecation.reason: Deprecated for removal in Reactor Netty.
